notes: Prepares an opened copy of configs/round9-cohort.json under {out}/run with 10,000 fresh deals (the capsule supplies only bots and artifacts; prepare takes .writer.lock in the capsule and checks STOP, WATCHDOG_STOP, no failures, episodes = receipts) and plays 2 deals of each of the 3 pairs through ops/smoke_gen7.py in one process (about 10 to 15 minutes). The script fetches two transfer branches (transfer/v41-training-families-union-20261112, transfer/gen9-cohort-inputs-20261113) with git in its checkout and checks their sha256 pins. Starts no collector and writes no feed. Needs TensorFlow (as the collectors do) and the built solver.
